# authwise_access_binding (Resource)

A binding that grants a subject a role in an audience's Access catalog.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `role_name` (String)
- `subject_id` (String)
- `subject_type` (String)

### Optional

- `audience_id` (String) Parent identifier `audience_id`; overrides the provider default. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `condition_id` (String)
- `expires_at` (String) `expires_at` as an RFC 3339 timestamp.
- `issuer_id` (String) Parent identifier `issuer_id`; overrides the provider default. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `resource_id` (String)
- `resource_type` (String)
- `tenant_id` (String) Parent identifier `tenant_id`; overrides the provider default. Changing it replaces the resource.

### Read-Only

- `access_binding_id` (String) Server-assigned resource id — the last segment of `name`, and what other resources' `*_id` attributes take.
- `created_by` (String)
- `name` (String) Full resource name; serves as the Terraform ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by full resource name.
terraform import authwise_access_binding.example tenants/t-01/issuers/i-01/audiences/a-01/access-bindings/ab-01
```
